Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
Daemonic Possession
Necromancy
2 Blood
nec Only usable when a minion controlled by another Methuselah has
been burned since your last turn. Move that minion from his owner's
ash heap to your ready region, put 1 blood or life from the blood bank
on the minion and tap the minion. You now control the minion.
NEC As above, but the minion is untapped.

Due to the new D action rules, does this mean that DP is now a D
action.

PS The abbreviation of this card's name is a horrendous pun....
